scope: Ten read-only routes and Execution table cases; reuse exact batch05 dedicated session and retained two Script fixtures. No new objects, resource edits/deletes, Task/Run/User/Group/Node/Agent/Script mutations.

cases.actions: Direct-open, refresh, use a visible safe sidebar link away/back, then browser back/forward.
cases.oracles: GET /api/schedules status/count; actual ready/empty/error state and row count, no row content stored.

cases.actions: Direct-open with no task_id, refresh, back/forward; do not choose a Task or save.
cases.oracles: Actual GETs, rendered title/default controls/required controls, zero POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE.

cases.actions: Direct-open, refresh, sidebar away/back and browser back/forward.
cases.oracles: GET /api/applications and actual related state GET status/count; ready/empty/error UI and visible row count. Store only safe counts/statuses, not application data.

cases.actions: Direct-open, refresh, sidebar away/back and browser back/forward.
cases.oracles: GET /api/artifacts status/count; ready/empty/error UI agrees with response; do not open or download artifact bodies.

cases.actions: Direct-open, refresh, use actual existing row link only if present, then browser back/forward.
cases.oracles: GET /api/executions status/count; table/empty/error and visible row count. Filter captured DOM to headings, controls and aggregate counts only; no task labels/output.

cases.actions: Direct-open the retained known owned Execution, refresh, back/forward to /executions.
cases.oracles: GET /api/executions/:owned status and visible state/status/log line counts only; no log text, command, token or Task detail body saved.

cases.actions: Direct-open, refresh, sidebar away/back and browser back/forward.
cases.oracles: GET /api/audit status/count; ready/empty/error and table row count. Never save audit row text, usernames, credential-related values or raw response.

cases.module: TanStack authenticated route fallback / not-found UI
cases.actions: Direct-open exact canonical invalid route, refresh, browser back/forward.
cases.oracles: Actual route URL, shell/not-found/redirect state, any GET status; no navigation beyond repair origin and no writes.

cases.module: features/executions list filter and shared DataTable
cases.actions: Use safe term derived from an actually visible status, guaranteed nonmatch, then actual Reset/clear.
cases.oracles: GET /api/executions count unchanged; matched count, no-result feedback, Reset restores dataset; never persist row text or outputs.

cases.actions: Use actual sortable status/time header and three fresh-ref clicks through asc/desc/clear.
cases.oracles: Capture order only as row IDs hashed to short stable aliases plus observed display-state class; compare against actual comparator and record header as next action. Zero writes.

sensitive_data_handling.executions: Do not save command/log text, Task labels, or output bodies; store only path/method/status/count/status enums/hash aliases.
sensitive_data_handling.audit_and_apps: Do not save user/audit row text or app data; store count/state booleans only.
sensitive_data_handling.network: Local whitelist of same-origin method/path/status/count only; never persist raw headers/body/token.
